Config through content's reader injected by app.module (falls back to a direct read when not injected, for the frozen kit). PUT stays planned until B1-13f. Known follow-ups recorded: the blocklist check borrows a second pool connection under the lock (needs a risk read-only port on the caller's transaction), and related_phone is an empty string for users without a phone.
